jobs.description:
As Warehouse Operator, you will execute in an accurate manner tasks concerning both the physical handling and administration aspect of goods that are received, stocked, delivered to internal customers and shipped to external contacts.

The assignment

• Make sure that goods are stored and registered in the appropriate location

• Stock counts

• Check stock of standard goods in the cleanroom and ensure sufficient and timely supply within shelf life and register accordingly

• Deliver goods to cleanroom upon request of internal customers and register accordingly

• Receive goods from internal customers, pack, label and ship to external location taking into account applicable legislation

• You work efficiently, accurately and neatly and have an eye for safety.

• You are energetic, not afraid of physical work and have a great sense of responsibility.

• Your team spirit guarantees a flexible working arrangement.

• You are fluent in Dutch and have a good knowledge of English.

• A certificate for operation of an electric stacker and forklift driving license is a plus.

• You preferably have several years of experience in administrative processing, experience with SAP is a plus.

Our customer, an innovative international organization in Leuven, is looking for an Administrative / Paralegal Officer to strengthen its team on a temporary basis. In this role, you will support business operations by managing contracts, quotations and purchase orders while working closely with both internal and external stakeholders.
 

Expectied tasks: 
 

As an Administrative / Paralegal Officer, you will play a key role in ensuring smooth administrative and contractual processes.
 

Your responsibilities include:
 

 
• Managing business contracts, including initiating approval workflows and coordinating electronic signatures.
 
• Drafting and processing business quotations while helping to standardize and optimize procedures.
 
• Reviewing purchase orders for completeness, consistency and accuracy before processing them.
 
• Communicating proactively with internal and external stakeholders regarding contract and order status.
 
• Building expertise in the business area you support, including customer requirements, contractual frameworks and quotation processes.
 
• Ensuring administrative accuracy and maintaining high-quality documentation. 

Your profile
 

 
• You have 3 to 5 years of experience in a medium to large-sized company, preferably within a complex business environment.
 
• You already gained initial experience in sales contract management, paralegal support, or a similar role.
 
• You are highly organized and able to manage priorities effectively.
 
• You work accurately and consistently deliver quality results.
 
• You thrive in a dynamic environment and adapt easily to changing processes.
 
• You can handle tight deadlines and a fast-paced workload.
 
• You are proficient with digital tools such as Microsoft Office, CRM systems, and document management platforms.
 
• You have excellent communication skills.
 
• You are fluent in English. Knowledge of Dutch is considered a strong asset.

Do you enjoy working with machines and have a technical, hands-on mindset? Are you detail-oriented and do you like to roll up your sleeves and get to work? Then this position as a die-cutter/machine setter in Sint-Amands might be right for you.
 

As a machine setter, you’ll be responsible for die-cutting boxes. You’ll set up the die-cutting machine, monitor the production process, and perform quality checks. In addition, you’ll carry out precision mechanical tasks and ensure that the finished products are properly stacked, sorted, or packaged.
 

Your responsibilities
 
 

• You’ll be responsible for setting up and monitoring the production process using the die-cutting machine. 

• You check the quality of the pieces. 

• You stack, sort, or package the finished product. 

• Additionally, you perform various precision mechanical tasks. 

• You ensure that operations run smoothly. 
 

• You speak and understand English well. 

• You have technical insight and/or have completed a technical education. 

• You are capable of performing physically demanding work. 

• You want to work in a production environment.

We are looking for a Data Engineer to support the development and maintenance of an Azure-based data platform, ensuring data is accessible, high-quality, and fit for purpose.This is a hands-on, execution-focused data engineering role, where you will work primarily on SQL transformations, data pipelines, and platform optimisation. You will contribute to building robust and scalable data solutions that enable analytics and reporting across the organisation.Key Responsibilities

• You build, monitor and optimize data pipelines using Azure Synapse and Data Factory
• You design and optimize data storage solutions (Azure Data Lake, Synapse Analytics)
• You develop and maintain scalable SQL transformations
• You ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across the platfform
• You collaborate with analysts and business teams to deliver reliable and usable datasets
• You support data governance, security, and compliance requirements

Your Profile 

• You bring solid experience in data engineering (min. 5 years), preferably within an Azure-based environment
• You have completed a master’s degree in Data, IT, or Economics, or you possess an equivalent level of analytical and practical skills based on your experience.
• You have strong SQL skills and experience with modern data platforms and transformation processes
• You communicate fluently in English, knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

jobs.occupation: Insitoo - Business Analyst - Payment & Card Expert
jobs.description:
Card Payments Team within a Belgian bank. Modernization and enhancement of card products and services.

Work arrangements: Full-time, 2 to 3 days of remote per week
Key responsibilities

• 
Incident analysis and identification of areas for improvement

• 
Assessment of change requests, business requirements, and acceptance criteria

• 
Definition of scope, target target operating model, and business-to-IT interfaces

• 
End-to-end implementation tracking up to User Acceptance Testing (UAT)

• 
Proven Business Analyst experience in a card/payments environment - Must have

• 
Strong knowledge of the Belgian card payments market - Must have

• 
Fluent in English, both written and spoken - Must have

• 
French and/or Dutch - Nice to have

• 
Experience as a Product Owner or within Agile frameworks - Nice to have

• 
Exposure to Wero, digital wallets, and card system architecture - Nice to have

jobs.occupation: Welder - Semi-automatic or TIG – Zwevegem – 2 Shift
jobs.description:
Title
Welder – Two-Shift Work
Job description
Looking for a full-time welding role in automotive parts manufacturing? This opportunity in Zwevegem starts as an interim assignment with the option of permanent employment. You’ll work with tube products and a range of materials.
A tube-products manufacturer
The company specializes in manufacturing tube products.
Your role
• Weld aluminum, stainless steel, and iron to create strong, precise joints.
• Carry out accurate welding work on tubes for different applications.
• Use TIG or semi-automatic welding equipment for the work at hand.
• Check your work carefully and make sure the finish meets quality specifications.
You’ll work in a two-shift schedule.
Company profile
Forum Jobs connects talent and companies through a personal approach and broad sector knowledge. As a full-service HR partner, it supports both candidates and employers, bringing a human touch to the recruitment process and helping people find opportunities that fit.

You’ll feel at home in this role if careful, skilled welding and pride in a quality finish are your kind of work.

• Your experience as a welder gives you a solid foundation, especially if you’ve worked with aluminum, stainless steel, and iron.
• TIG welding feels familiar to you, and you’re comfortable working with semi-automatic welding equipment.
• You notice the small details that make a difference and take pride in delivering high-quality work.
• You enjoy working as part of a team, adapt flexibly, and make safety a priority for yourself and those around you.
• You can communicate in English, Dutch, or French, and can provide a reference from a former employer.

As a Team Leader within the logistics department, you are responsible for leading and supporting a team of warehouse employees, with a focus on the efficient handling, storage, and distribution of goods. You ensure that operational targets are achieved and that safety and quality standards are consistently followed.

The role consists of four key areas of responsibility. In addition, you are willing to work operationally alongside your team when necessary.

 
• 
Team Leadership: Train, manage, motivate, and support your team to achieve operational targets, while identifying training and development needs.

 
• 
Operational Management: Monitor workflows related to the receipt, storage, picking, packing, and shipment of parts.

 
• 
Performance & Reporting: Monitor team performance and results and report these to the Supervisor.

 
• 
Problem Solving: Resolve minor operational issues and escalate more complex problems when necessary.

 
• 
Strong leadership and people management skills.

 
• 
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

 
• 
Excellent command of the English language.

 
• 
Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.

 
• 
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

 
• 
Ability to work under pressure and adapt to changing priorities.

 
• 
Experience in warehouse management or a similar role, preferably within the automotive sector.

As a 
field service engineer, you'll be the technical expert customers rely on to keep their industrial equipment running smoothly.
 

You'll work both 
on-site at customer facilities across the EMEA region and 
at the technical service center in Merchtem, combining hands-on troubleshooting, maintenance, and repairs with direct customer support.
 

Your responsibilities will include:
 
 

• Technical troubleshooting: Diagnose, analyze, and resolve issues with industrial measurement equipment, electronic systems, and process control technologies. 

• Installation & commissioning: Install, configure, and commission advanced technical equipment at customer sites throughout the EMEA region. 

• Maintenance & repairs: Perform technical repairs, preventive maintenance, and failure analysis, both on-site and at the workshop in Merchtem. 

• Customer support: Provide professional technical assistance, both remotely and in person, ensuring customers receive efficient and reliable solutions. 

• Technical training: Guide customers in the correct use, maintenance, and operation of their equipment. 

• Continuous improvement: Collaborate with international engineering and technical teams to identify recurring issues and contribute to product and service improvements. 

• Reporting & follow-up: Document technical interventions, maintain accurate service records, and take ownership of your assigned cases from start to finish.  

You'll spend approximately 
40–50% of your time travelling internationally, while the remaining time will mainly be dedicated to technical repairs, diagnostics, and support activities at the Merchtem service center.

What makes you a great match?
 
 

• You are 
fluent in Dutch, French, English, and German, allowing you to communicate confidently with customers and colleagues across the EMEA region. 

• You have a solid understanding of 
electrical systems, industrial electronics, and wiring. 

• You have hands-on experience in 
troubleshooting and repairing industrial electronics or control systems. 

• Ideally, you have at least 
2 years of experience in field service, industrial maintenance, or a manufacturing environment. 

• Experience with 
measurement equipment, process control systems, or industrial communication protocols (Modbus, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, and PROFIBUS) is a strong advantage. 

• You're 
independent, proactive, and reliable, taking full ownership of your tasks and following through on your commitments. 

• You're 
customer-oriented and communicative, keeping customers and colleagues informed throughout the process. 

• You're comfortable working with 
targets, KPIs, and service deadlines while maintaining high-quality standards. 

• You're flexible and enthusiastic about 
international travel (approximately 50%), including overnight stays across the EMEA region. 

• You hold a 
valid driver's license and have a clean driving record.

Do you have a passion for technology and are you looking for a challenging job with responsibility?Become a bending machine operator in an innovative production environment! You'll bend pipes of various sizes, cut them to length where needed, and remove burrs. The work can be physically demanding, especially with larger pipes. Experience in the metal industry is a strong plus.

What are you tasks?

• 
Operate and set up the bending machine to ensure precise pipe shaping.

• 
Monitor the process and intervene in case of malfunctions to guarantee a perfect end product.

• 
2-shift system!

Dutch and/or English language skills are required.

Your profile:

• 
You have technical knowledge or experience in a similar role.

• 
Accuracy and attention to detail are your strong suits.

• 
You are eager to learn and interested in automation and production processes.

• 
You can work independently, but also thrive in a team environment.

• 
Safety and quality are always your top priorities.

As a welder, you are responsible for manual and semi-automatic welding of different parts. You work precisely and have an eye for quality, because your workmanship directly impacts the final product.

A typical day involves reading technical plans, preparing materials, and handling welding tasks according to given specifications. You assemble the welded components into a solid, durable end product. You work independently, but can also cooperate with other skilled workers when needed.

Are you handy, detail-oriented, and do you take pride in a perfectly finished product? Then this job is for you. Apply now and show your skills!

• You have a technical background or proven welding experience.

• You can read and accurately follow technical plans.

• You are physically fit and enjoy hands-on work.

• You like working independently and pay attention to detail.

• You speak, write, and understand English.

Who are you?
